Market today: The mood is cautious, with headlines suggesting investors are looking beyond tech and chips. This is a direct hit to your concentrated portfolio, especially with Nvidia and AMD falling.

Your holdings: MUU (-16.32%), SOXL (-42.87%), and SPAL (-21.35%) are all leveraged ETFs flagged "SELL." Their decay and your significant losses, amplified by margin, demand immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on overall semiconductor performance and any further rotation out of tech. Your leveraged positions are particularly vulnerable.

Bottom line: Your heavy tech/chip concentration and leveraged losses are a serious concern in this shifting market.
plays: Review MUU, SOXL, and SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are decaying and showing deep losses; consider trimming or exiting to reduce margin risk.
Respect the stop on SOXL at 200.00; a break below this level could signal further downside for your largest leveraged loss.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market sentiment for tech/chips is too uncertain to initiate new long positions.
